fixed.item: review G10 / L3: at boil-over a litre of milk vanished in one 30 s step, then the empty pot heated to ~400 C with _vessel.scorched unset
fixed.how: stove._boil_over caps what goes over per substep at BOIL_OVER_L_PER_KJ = 5 ml per kJ of boiling power (foam is mostly steam; min 20 ml; never more than stands above the rim): ~0.26 l per 30 s on a coil on high; a pot that boils dry by boiling over is boil_dry too, and a pot that boiled dry with milk, stock, sauce or food in it scorches its bottom above 150 C (_vessel.residue, _vessel.scorched, burnt soil). Plain water leaves nothing to scorch; the empty pan's own scorched/damage at 260 C is unchanged
